definitions.explanation: A cloud of smoke released to conceal military movements or positions from the enemy.
Something designed to hide the truth or distract attention from the real issue.

examples.japanese: ⟦{軍|ぐん}→軍：02677_gun⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{煙幕|えんまく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{張|は}って→張る：12583_haru⟧⟦{撤退|てったい}した→撤退する：25360_tettaisuru⟧。
examples.english: The army retreated under cover of a smokescreen.

examples.japanese: {煙幕|えんまく}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{視界|しかい}→視界：14137_shikai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{遮|さえぎ}られ→遮る：10876_saegiru⟧、⟦{敵|てき}→敵：03546_teki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{動|うご}き→動き：11926_ugoki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{見|み}えなく→見える：01165_mieru⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: The smokescreen blocked the view, making it impossible to see the enemy's movements.

examples.japanese: ⟦{上陸|じょうりく}→上陸：20591_jouriku⟧⟦{作戦|さくせん}→作戦：09673_sakusen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{際|さい}→際：02819_sai⟧、⟦{艦隊|かんたい}→艦隊：14076_kantai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{煙幕|えんまく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{張|は}って→張る：12583_haru⟧⟦{部隊|ぶたい}→部隊：28119_butai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{接近|せっきん}→接近：04365_sekkin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{隠|かく}した→隠す：02034_kakusu⟧。
examples.english: During the landing operation, the fleet laid a smokescreen to conceal the approach of the troops.

examples.japanese: ⟦あの→あの：00915_ano⟧⟦{発言|はつげん}→発言：05099_hatsugen⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{煙幕|えんまく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧すぎない。
examples.english: That statement is nothing but a smokescreen.

examples.japanese: ⟦{政府|せいふ}→政府：03294_seifu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{煙幕|えんまく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{張|は}って→張る：12583_haru⟧⟦{本当|ほんとう}→本当：00779_hontou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{目|め}→目：00525_me⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧そらそう⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: The government is putting up a smokescreen to divert attention from the real issue.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{巧|たく}み→巧み：07153_takumi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{煙幕|えんまく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{張|は}り→張る：12583_haru⟧、⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{関与|かんよ}→関与：08646_kanyo⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{隠|かく}し→隠す：02034_kakusu⟧⟦{通|とお}した→通す：02300_toosu⟧。
examples.english: He skillfully put up a smokescreen and managed to conceal his involvement.

notes:
{煙幕|えんまく} literally means "smoke curtain." The figurative sense (diversion, cover-up) is far more common in modern usage than the military sense.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {煙幕|えんまく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{張|は}る→張る：12583_haru⟧ (to put up a smokescreen — literal or figurative)
- {煙幕|えんまく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧すぎない (nothing but a smokescreen)
- {煙幕|えんまく}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{隠|かく}す→隠す：02034_kakusu⟧ (to hide with a smokescreen)
- {煙幕|えんまく}{弾|だん} (smoke grenade — military)

USAGE:
In politics, business, and daily life, {煙幕|えんまく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{張|は}る→張る：12583_haru⟧ means to create a distraction to conceal the real issue. This is the sense learners will encounter most often in news and conversation.

ETYMOLOGY:
From {煙|えん} (smoke) + ⟦{幕|まく}→幕：12518_maku⟧ (curtain/screen). Originally a military term for smoke deployed to hide troop movements.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {目|め}くらまし: diversion, distraction
- ごまかす: to deceive, to cover up
